case.question: How can we practise taking turns in play?

retrieved.text: Practise taking turns by pulling clothing items out of a cloth bag together. Name each item as you play.
retrieved.title: Taking turns with clothes while getting dressed
retrieved.source_title: NHS: First words and little sentences, 1 to 2 years

retrieved.text: Play a pretend teddy-bear picnic together or pretend to wash a doll. Talk about your actions and name the doll's body parts as part of the game.
retrieved.title: Pretend games with a teddy or doll
retrieved.source_title: NHS: First words and little sentences, 1 to 2 years

If so, you can try this activity:
* Pull clothing items out of a cloth bag together.
* Name each item as you play.
